task_completion.description: The agent opened the draw.io application and accessed the source data files (pedigree_data.txt or pedigree_conventions.txt).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the draw.io interface and the text files open in a text editor or terminal.

task_completion.description: The chart contains 4 distinct generations (I-IV) with at least 24 individual shapes connected by mating and descent lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A multi-tiered pedigree chart in the draw.io canvas with Roman numerals I, II, III, and IV labeling the rows.

task_completion.description: The chart uses standard pedigree symbols (squares for males, circles for females) and visual encoding (shading/dots) for affected and carrier statuses.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Squares and circles on the canvas, some of which are filled or marked differently to indicate hemophilia status as per the conventions.

task_completion.description: Key individuals including Victoria, Albert, and Alice are labeled by name within the chart.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text labels 'Victoria', 'Albert', and 'Alice' appearing next to or inside specific shapes in the pedigree.

task_completion.description: A legend is present explaining the symbols used for unaffected, affected, and carrier individuals.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A separate box or area on the draw.io canvas labeled 'Legend' or 'Key' with symbol definitions.

task_completion.description: The diagram is saved as 'royal_hemophilia_pedigree.drawio' and exported as a PDF to the Diagrams folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The draw.io title bar showing the correct filename and a file manager or terminal view showing the .drawio and .pdf files in ~/Diagrams/.

integrity.description: The agent used the draw.io GUI to construct the diagram rather than generating it via script or command line only.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with draw.io shapes, connection points, and menu items.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-existing image or PDF but built the diagram within the tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the progressive addition of shapes and lines to the draw.io canvas.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the provided text files to retrieve the pedigree data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the content of 'pedigree_data.txt' or 'pedigree_conventions.txt' being viewed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The pedigree must contain 4 generations. Generation I consists of Victoria and Albert. Total individuals should be approximately 26 (Gen I: 2, Gen II: 5, Gen III: 8, Gen IV: 11). Required names to be visible: Victoria, Albert, Alice. The output must be saved to /home/ga/Diagrams/royal_hemophilia_pedigree.drawio and exported to /home/ga/Diagrams/royal_hemophilia_pedigree.pdf. Standard symbols: Square=Male, Circle=Female.
